The induced dependence graph is an h-clique plus isolated loops, giving dAvg=a,dMax=h. These bounded outcomes satisfy uniform regularity, restricted interference, dAvg=O(1), and dMax=sqrt(n). The normalized centered HT variable is exactly f, with masses (1/4,1/2,1/4). This explicit outcome-family verification is mathematical; the full existential construction was not re-proved in Lean.
